ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and send the driver's arrival confirmation for account review for abuse of the cancellation/waiting button + flag_account
ruling.reasoning: The driver cancelled (cancelled_by = driver, F3) and claimed a rider no-show, so the case enters the NS group through NS-0 [F3][NS-0]. The trace settles the three NS-1 elements against the driver: arrival was confirmed by his own tap (F5), but at that moment the GPS placed him 600 m from the pickup, far outside the 200 m arrival radius, and his closest approach over the whole episode was 599 m (F1, F5) — his message "I'm here already" (F8) is contradicted by GPS, and system records outrank statements [F1][F5][F8][NS-1]. He then stayed within the radius for 0 s (F5), and the platform never recorded him at the pickup (driver_arrived_at null, F4) [F4][F5][NS-1]. Because NS-1 (ii) and (iii) both fail, NS-1 does not hold and NS-2 requires the $6.61 cancellation fee to be refunded in full [F3][F5][F6][NS-2]. The rider's own account in the chat — at the pickup, no car there (F9) — matches the GPS record, and the driver's post-trip statement that he waited at the pickup (F12) is a claim, not a record, and cannot override it [F9][F12][NS-1]. The rider's profile (0 disputes, 0 upheld, F16) is not used to decide the case; the driver's prior upheld no-show dispute (F17) is likewise only relevant to the account action [F16][F17][RD-6]. Amount: the disputed item is the cancellation fee recorded at $6.61 (F3, F6), refunded in full — $6.61 [F6][NS-2][NS-7]; the fee is returned as a Ryde voucher and Ryde retains final discretion [NS-7]. Separately, the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS showed him 600 m away (F5, F1), which is the abuse-of-cancellation/waiting-button conduct NS-2 attaches an account flag to [F1][F5][NS-2]; the trace marks flag_account required, and with one prior upheld no-show dispute within 90 days the repeated-violation branch also supports it [F17][RD-6].

actions.detail: account action is never automatic; queued for Ryde review

what_would_change: Had NS-1 (ii) and (iii) both held ((ii) within 200 m of pickup AT THE MOMENT of the arrival confirmation; (iii) stayed at the pickup more than 3 min after the arrival confirmation, until cancelling (NS-1 default: more than 3 min)), the fee would stand and no refund would be due.
